kaikki_vikisozluk.e: فِرْصِن or فُرْصُن • (firṣin or furṣun) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: An Aramaic borrowing, found in Classical Syriac ܦܪܨܢܐ (parṣennē), singulative ܦܪܨܢܬܐ (parṣentā), Jewish Babylonian Aramaic פּוּרְצְנֵי (purṣənē, “kernels especially of grapes”). See also فِرْصَاد (firṣād), فِرْصِيد (firṣīd) from פַּרְצֵידָא (parṣīḏā, “seed, kernel, pip”). The trailing variation in ـم (-m) is typical of Arabic, we have noted on إِبْزِيم (ʔibzīm, “clasp”), مِيجَم (mījam, “fuller’s beetle”) and كَرْزَم (karzam, “one-sided axe”).
s: Jewish Babylonian Aramaic פּוּרְצְנֵי (purṣənē, “kernels especially of grapes”)
